title: DishPreparedEvent
description: Repeatable event emitted when a kitchen dish is marked prepared (RF-10, RF-19).

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this preparation emission.

orderId.description: Public identifier of the affected order.

itemId.description: Public identifier of the prepared order item.

offerId.description: Catalog offer identifier prepared for Inventory consumption.

plateId.description: Inventory plate/recipe identifier corresponding to Menu sourceId.

isRedo.description: Whether this preparation is an extraordinary redo.
